items.definition:
the action of distorting or the state of being distorted
The mirror caused a strange distortion of her face.

the fact of having a right to something
He acted with a sense of entitlement, expecting special treatment.

the state of being diminished, weakened, or damaged
His vision impairment made it difficult to read small print.

long existence or service
The company's longevity is a testament to its strong leadership.

a body of traditions and knowledge on a subject or held by a particular group, typically passed from person to person by word of mouth
Ancient folklore is full of fascinating lore about mythical creatures.

a leader or savior
Many people hoped he would be the messiah to solve their problems.

a long and adventurous journey or experience
His life has been an incredible odyssey of discovery and adventure.

the action of returning an attack or injury
The attack was carried out in retaliation for earlier aggression.

the quality of being concerned with the human spirit or soul
Many people find comfort in spirituality.

the academic world
She decided to pursue a career in academia.

official recognition or approval
The university received full accreditation for its new program.

a simple non-flowering plant
Alga can grow quickly in stagnant water.

a heat-resistant fibrous silicate mineral
Old buildings often contain asbestos.

the process of becoming stronger and more confident, especially in controlling one's life
Education is key to women's empowerment.

the ability to understand something immediately, without conscious reasoning
She had a strong intuition that something was wrong.

the German or Austrian emperor
The Kaiser ruled Germany during World War I.

a college that trains priests, ministers, or rabbis
He decided to attend a seminary to study theology.

the process of writing down something spoken
The transcription of the interview took several hours.

an extremely wicked or cruel act
The war was marked by numerous atrocities.

the underlying reason or justification
The committee explained the rationale behind their decision.

the improvement or amendment of what is wrong, corrupt, or unsatisfactory
The Reformation was a major movement in European history.

a substance that can conduct electricity under certain conditions
Silicon is a widely used semiconductor material.

cautious and surreptitious action or movement
The cat moved with great stealth towards the bird.

the arrangement of words and phrases
Understanding the syntax of a language is crucial for writing correctly.

a bicycle for two people; in conjunction
They worked in tandem to complete the project on time.

a group of people leading the way
The company is at the vanguard of technological innovation.

a turning point; an area of land that drains into a river
The invention of the internet was a watershed moment in human history.

a state of disorder due to absence of authority
The sudden collapse of the government led to anarchy in the streets.

the expression of very strong disapproval
The act received widespread condemnation from the international community.

impairment or abnormality in the function of a bodily organ or system; disruption of normal social relations
The family suffered from severe dysfunction.

a gift of money or property to an institution or individual
The university received a generous endowment from an anonymous donor.

the action of erecting something; a structure that has been erected
The erection of the new building took several months.

the animals of a particular region
The local fauna includes deer and foxes.

loyalty or accuracy
He swore fidelity to his country.

the leading position
She is at the forefront of medical research.

inflammation of the liver
Hepatitis can be caused by a virus.

danger of loss, harm, or failure
His life was in great jeopardy.

prejudice, stereotyping, or discrimination, typically against women
The company was accused of sexism in its hiring practices.

a state of great disturbance, confusion, or uncertainty
The country was in political turmoil after the election.

cruel and oppressive government or rule
The people rebelled against the tyranny of the dictator.

a short biographical sketch or summary of one's career
Please attach your full vita to the application.

a low dam built across a river to raise the level of water upstream or regulate its flow
The salmon were unable to jump over the new weir.

the action or an act of abolishing a system, practice, or institution
The abolition of slavery was a major turning point in history.

The universe regarded as a complex and orderly system; a genus of flowering plants.
Scientists study the vastness of the cosmos.

The action of deposing someone, especially a monarch; the process of giving sworn evidence; the natural process of laying down a substance.
The lawyer took the witness's deposition.

Careful and persistent work or effort.
Her diligence in studying led to excellent grades.

a small remaining quantity of something
Only a small remnant of the ancient forest remains today.

the action of subduing someone or something by force; the act of suppressing a thought or desire in oneself
The government used repression to control dissent.

eighteenth letter of the Greek alphabet
In statistics, sigma often represents standard deviation.

a group of individuals or organizations combined to promote a common interest
The crime syndicate controlled the illegal gambling operations.

a district under the pastoral care of a bishop
The bishop oversees the churches in his diocese.

a political philosophy
Liberalism emphasizes individual rights and freedoms.

narcotic
The doctor prescribed a strong narcotic for the pain.

pilgrimage
Many people make a pilgrimage to the holy site.

profitability
The company's profitability improved this quarter.

regression
The data showed a clear regression over time.

the act of using something
The efficient utilization of resources is key to success.

the sequence of steps and movements in a dance
The choreography for the ballet was stunning.

act of distinguishing
There is a clear differentiation between the two species.

ordinary people
The movement started at the grassroots level.

a pause or break
The band announced a hiatus.

A struggle or striving, especially a religious one.
The concept of jihad is complex and often misunderstood.

A countless or extremely great number.
There are a myriad of reasons to visit this city.

deep regret or guilt
He felt deep remorse for his actions.
